changelog:
v2.10.5 - Fast Direct send.

- Direct send now shrinks the video on your phone first (720p, ~2.5 Mbps): a 22 MB clip becomes ~2-3 MB and uploads in seconds.
- Real progress bar with percent for both shrinking and uploading (no more frozen 'Uploading...').
- Original recording is never changed; if shrinking fails it sends the original.
